payload.title: Operator identity can file AI proposals (S)
payload.description: An IAM operator role of the site's own account can file AI proposals (fileProposal) and move a draft to in_steering or declined (transitionProposal), recorded as operator:<ARN> in the history. IAM can never approve, review-decide or override; identity-pool users and other accounts are refused. CLI (papyrus proposals create|transition|publish with PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH=iam) and the idea pipeline --store proposals use it. Unblocks PPY-8ffc18, scheduled automations and Shipped's first proposal. Docs: reader-steering.md Operator filing, idea-pipeline.md.
